text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: Q,* and the glorious Quran. 2.
text_1989: Q., and the glorious Quran.*
footnote_1989: *50:1 See Appendix 1 for the awesome miracles connected with the Initial “Q. ” 0 2404 Q (Qaaf) 50:16-35 r 519
text_ref: Q., and the glorious Quran.*
footnote_ref: *50:1 See Appendix 1 for the awesome miracles connected with the Initial Q (ق).

text_1981: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, "This is really strange.
text_1989: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, “This is really strange.
text_ref: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, "This is really strange.

text_1981: “After we die and turn to dust?
text_1989: “After we die and become dust; this is impossible.”
text_ref: "After we die and become dust; this is impossible."

text_1981: We are fully aware of any one of them who gets consumed by the earth; we have an accurate record.
text_1989: We are fully aware of any one of them who gets consumed by the earth; we have an accurate record.
text_ref: We are fully aware of any one of them who gets consumed by the earth; we have an accurate record.

text_1981: They rejected the truth when it came to them; they are utterly confused.
text_1989: They rejected the truth when it came to them; they are utterly confused.
text_ref: They rejected the truth when it came to them; they are utterly confused.

text_1981: Have they not looked at the sky above them, and how we constructed it and adorned it, without a flaw?
text_1989: Have they not looked at the sky above them, and how we constructed it and adorned it, without a flaw?
text_ref: Have they not looked at the sky above them, and how we constructed it and adorned it, without a flaw?

text_1981: And we created the earth, and scattered on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of beautiful plants.
text_1989: And we created the earth, and scat­ tered on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of beautiful plants.
text_ref: And we created the earth, and scattered on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of beautiful plants.

text_1981: This is to enlighten and remind every obedient person. 9.
text_1989: This is an enlightenment, and a re­ minder for every pious worshiper.
text_ref: This is an enlightenment, and a reminder for every pious worshiper.

text_1981: And we sent from the sky blessed water, to grow with it gardens and grains to be harvested.
text_1989: And we sent from the sky blessed water, to grow with it gardens and grains to be harvested.
text_ref: And we sent from the sky blessed water, to grow with it gardens and grains to be harvested.

text_1981: And tall palms with clustered fruits. 11.
text_1989: Tall date palms, with clustered fruit.
text_ref: Tall date palms, with clustered fruit.

text_1981: Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.
text_1989: Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.
text_ref: Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.

text_1981: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Russ, and Thamûd.
text_1989: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Russ, and Thamoud.
text_ref: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Russ, and Thamûd.

text_1981: Also, Aad, Pharaoh, and the brethren* of Lot.
text_1989: And Aad, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.
text_ref: And 'Ãd, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.

text_1981: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba'. All of them disbelieved the messengers and, consequently, My retribution befell them.
text_1989: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba‘. All of them dis­ believed the messengers and, consequently, My retribution befell them.
text_ref: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba'. All of them disbelieved the messengers and, consequently, My retribution befell them.

text_1981: Were we too burdened by the first creation? Is this why they doubt resurrection?
text_1989: Were we too burdened by the first creation? Is this why they doubt resurrection?
text_ref: Were we too burdened by the first creation? Is this why they doubt resurrection?

text_1981: We created the human, and we know what he whispers to himself. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
text_1989: We created the human, and we know what he whispers to himself. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
text_ref: We created the human, and we know what he whispers to himself. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

text_1981: Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.
text_1989: Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.
text_ref: Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.

text_1981: Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.
text_1989: Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.
text_ref: Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.

text_1981: Finally, the inevitable coma of death comes; this is what you tried to evade.
text_1989: Finally, the inevitable coma of death comes; this is what you tried to evade.
text_ref: Finally, the inevitable coma of death comes; this is what you tried to evade.

text_1981: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.
footnote_1981: 50:20-29. happenings that took place on the day of judgment. is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.
text_1989: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.
text_ref: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.

text_1981: Every soul came, along with a herder and a witness. 22.
text_1989: Every soul comes with a herder and a witness.
text_ref: Every soul comes with a herder and a witness.

text_1981: You used to be oblivious to this. We now remove your veil; today, your vision is (as strong as) steel.
text_1989: You used to be oblivious to this. your vision is (as strong as) steel.
text_ref: You used to be oblivious to this. We now remove your veil; today, your vision is (as strong as) steel.

text_1981: The companion said, "Here is my formidable testimony."*
footnote_1981: *50:23-28 Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.
text_1989: The companion said, “Here is my formidable testimony.”*
text_ref: The companion said, "Here is my formidable testimony."*
footnote_ref: *50:23-28 Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.

text_1981: Throw into hell every stubborn disbeliever.
text_1989: Throw into Gehenna every stubborn disbeliever.
text_ref: Throw into Gehenna every stubborn disbeliever.

text_1981: He was an opponent of righteousness; transgressor, and doubtful. 26.
text_1989: Forbidder of charity, aggressor, full of doubt.
text_ref: Forbidder of charity, aggressor, full of doubt.

text_1981: He set up besides GOD another god. Throw him into severe retribution.
text_1989: He set up besides GOD another god Throw him into severe retribution.
text_ref: He set up besides GOD another god. Throw him into severe retribution.

text_1981: His companion said, "Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he was far astray."
text_1989: His companion said, “Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he was far astray.”
text_ref: His companion said, "Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he was far astray."

text_1981: He said, "Do not feud in front of Me; I have sufficiently warned you.
text_1989: He said, “Do not feud in front of Me I have sufficiently warned you.
text_ref: He said, "Do not feud in front of Me; I have sufficiently warned you.

text_1981: “Nothing can be changed now;* I am never unjust towards the people.” 30.
footnote_1981: 50:29. soul that is strong, well fed, and well developed (as a result of heeding God’s message), or a soul that is weak, shrunk, and undeveloped (as a result of disregarding God’s message). growth and development completely up to us. See Appendix 10.
text_1989: “Nothing can be changed now. I am never unjust towards the people.”
text_ref: "Nothing can be changed now. I am never unjust towards the people."

text_1981: That is the day when we ask Hell, "Have you had enough?" It will say, "Give me more."
text_1989: That is the day when we ask Hell, “Have you had enough?” It will say, “Give me more.”
text_ref: That is the day when we ask Hell, "Have you had enough?" It will say, "Give me more."

text_1981: Paradise will be presented to the righteous, very close.
text_1989: Paradise will be offered to the righteous, readily.
text_ref: Paradise will be offered to the righteous, readily.

text_1981: This is what has been promised for every steadfast submitter. 33.
text_1989: This is what was promised to every repenter, steadfast.
text_ref: This is what was promised to every repenter, steadfast.

text_1981: They reverenced the Most Gracious, in their privacy, and came wholeheartedly.
text_1989: They reverenced the Most Gracious, in their privacy, and came wholeheartedly.
text_ref: They reverenced the Most Gracious, in their privacy, and came wholeheartedly.

text_1981: Enter it in peace; this is the day of eternity.
text_1989: Enter it in peace; this is the Day of Eternity.
text_ref: Enter it in peace; this is the Day of Eternity.

text_1981: They have deserved whatever they wish therein, and we have even more.
text_1989: They get anything they wish therein, and we have even more.
text_ref: They get anything they wish therein, and we have even more.

text_1981: Many a generation before them, who were more powerful, we annihilated. They searched the land; did they find an escape?
text_1989: Many a generation before them, who were more powerful, we annihilated. did they find an escape?
text_ref: Many a generation before them, who were more powerful, we annihilated. They searched the land; did they find an escape?

text_1981: This should be a lesson for everyone who possesses a mind, or is able to hear and witness.
text_1989: This should be a lesson for everyone who possesses a mind, or is able to hear and witness.
text_ref: This should be a lesson for everyone who possesses a mind, or is able to hear and witness.

text_1981: We have created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched us.
text_1989: We have created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched us.
text_ref: We have created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched us.

text_1981: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise, and before sunset.
text_1989: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise, and before sunset.
text_ref: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise, and before sunset.

text_1981: Glorify Him during the night, and in prostration.
text_1989: During the night you shall meditate on His name, and after prostrating.
text_ref: During the night you shall meditate on His name, and after prostrating.

text_1981: Beware of the day when the caller calls from a near place.
text_1989: Prepare for the day when the caller calls from a place that is near.
text_ref: Prepare for the day when the caller calls from a place that is near.

text_1981: When they hear the truthful blow; this is the day of resurrection.
text_1989: When they hear the inevitable cry; that is the day you come out.
text_ref: When they hear the inevitable cry; that is the day you come out.

text_1981: It is we who give life and death, and to us is the ultimate destiny. 44.
text_1989: We are the ones who control life and death; to us is the final destiny.
text_ref: We are the ones who control life and death; to us is the final destiny.

text_1981: The day will come when the earth cracks in a hurry, giving rise to them. Such summoning is easy for us to do.
text_1989: The day will come when the earth cracks in a hurry, giving rise to them. Such summoning is easy for us to do.
text_ref: The day will come when the earth cracks in a hurry, giving rise to them. Such summoning is easy for us to do.

text_1981: We are fully aware of what they say, while you can never force them. Therefore, remind with the Quran* those who reverence My warning.
text_1989: We are fully aware of everything they utter, while you have no power over them. My warnings.
text_ref: We are fully aware of everything they utter, while you have no power over them. Therefore, remind with this Quran, those who reverence My warnings.
